editorial.blurb: A hidden-gem lakefront spot where beautiful views, kind hospitality, and crave-worthy seafood dishes make every visit feel like a summer escape.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit on a perfect weather day to fully enjoy the Lake Michigan views from the outdoor seating, and ask about the cash discount at checkout.

topDishes.note: Cold, perfectly prepared—the star of the menu
Amazing and highly praised by regulars
